description: Curated interview question bank for the Software Engineer role. Each question is tagged with a difficulty level and the skill dimension it probes.

questions.text: Explain the difference between an array and a linked list, and when you would prefer one over the other.
What is the difference between a process and a thread?
Explain what an index does in a database and why too many indexes can be a problem.
Tell me about a bug that took you a long time to find. How did you finally track it down?
How would you detect a cycle in a linked list? Walk me through your approach and its time complexity.
Explain how a hash map works internally, including how collisions are handled.
What happens, step by step, when you type a URL into a browser and press enter?
Explain REST and how it differs from GraphQL. When would you choose each?
Design a URL shortener like bit.ly. What are the main components and how do they interact?
Describe a disagreement you had with a teammate about a technical decision. How was it resolved?
How would you find the kth largest element in an unsorted array? Compare two approaches.
Design a rate limiter for an API that serves millions of requests per minute. How do you make it distributed?
How would you design a notification system that delivers push, email, and SMS reliably at scale?
Explain how you would implement an LRU cache. What data structures would you combine and why?
Your API's p99 latency suddenly doubled overnight with no new deploy. How do you investigate?
Tell me about a time you had to learn a completely new technology under a tight deadline.
Design a chat application supporting one-on-one and group messaging with delivery receipts.
How does garbage collection work in a language like Java or Go? What are the trade-offs of different strategies?
